answer: One concrete defense is bonding: every agent must lock a costly stake to act, so minting fake identities stops being free. Treat that stake like basalt, dense and hard to forge at scale, anchoring each reputation. Newcomers must cross a bridge of attestations from established peers before gaining trust, leaving cheap sybils stranded on a knoll of zero bond, slashable the instant they cheat, making a thousand fake agents economically ruinous.
